fact: On 8 October 2025 the Egyptian Tax Authority head said the unified payroll tax platform calculates tax on salaries of all sectors electronically, integrates with employers' payroll systems and passes the claim electronically to the comprehensive tax automation system for payment, with an employee portal issuing payslips.
title: منظومة توحيد أسس ومعايير احتساب ضريبة الأجور والمرتبات يساهم في تحقيق العدالة الضريبية
